From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evan Ross <evan.ross@novara.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@novara.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-20 09:12 -07:00
Subject: Joint MAP: 30-day evaluation worksheet and close timeline

Hi Evan / Priya —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our conversation I sketched a compact MAP that outlines the technical checkpoints, success criteria, and a week-by-week close timeline to get to a pilot in 30 days. The idea is to keep the first sprint narrow (inference latency, sample throughput, and a small acceptance test set) and surface integration blockers early.

Files attached / linked:
- novara-week0-map-stub.gdoc (co-edit link) — working MAP doc with lanes for Product, Security, and Engineering
- 30d-eval-worksheet-v1.xlsx — acceptance checklist + sample data template
- close-timeline-sketch.pptx — one-slide timeline for execs

Next steps I suggest:
1) Quick sync to review success criteria (30 min) — can we do Tue 9/21 at 11am PT?
2) Ben and Marissa to join technical pre-read and comment in the MAP doc by EOD Mon.
3) Priya to confirm who from Novara Product/Engineering should be on the acceptance checklist column.

If that schedule works I’ll send a calendar invite with the pre-read attached.

Thanks,
Hannah

Thanks Hannah — this looks clear and actionable. Quick notes from our side:
- Tue 9/21 11am PT works for Evan + Priya. We’ll invite our lead infra engineer (Rohit) to the call.
- On the acceptance checklist: we need a section for data governance (PII handling) and an infra validation row that covers GPU sizing and estimated cost.
- For the sample data template, can you confirm if Redwood needs a hashed sample or full de-identified records? We prefer hashed/sample-first.

I’ll mark up the GDoc after the sync and loop Rohit into the MAP where technical tasks are listed.

Best,
Evan

Evan / Priya — thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap and validation:

- Workshop scheduled: Tue 2026-09-28 11:00am PT (30 min) — calendar invite sent.
- Action owners assigned in the MAP doc: Ben (infra validation checklist), Marissa (measurable acceptance criteria), Rohit (Novara infra owner to verify GPU sizing).
- Data template: Novara will provide hashed sample records; Redwood will supply a small ingestion script to validate tokenization and latency against our runtime.
- Security row: Priya to confirm SOC 2 evidence items needed for the acceptance column (we captured this in the MAP doc under Security -> Evidence).

Links: novara-week0-map-stub.gdoc (co-edit) — request: please add owners directly in the doc so the weekly checklist auto-assigns.

I’ve attached the updated worksheet with Ben’s infra rows and Marissa’s acceptance measures (see 30d-eval-worksheet-v1.xlsx v2 included inline in the doc). If anything above is incorrect please flag inline. Otherwise we’ll treat these as firm for the 30-day pilot plan.

Looking forward — Hannah
